Academic Leave Regulation

Section 1. Purpose
Students enrolled in degree programs may request academic leave when personal or medical circumstances prevent continued study.

Section 2. Request Procedure
Students may request academic leave by submitting a formal written request to the academic office. The request must include the reason for leave and the expected duration.

Section 3. Duration
Academic leave may be granted for up to 12 months per request. Extensions require a new application.

Section 4. Reinstatement
Students must notify the academic office at least 30 days before returning from academic leave.
